title: Ushirika: Cooperatives and SACCOS in Tanzania
subtitle: Loan access, poverty and the impact of cooperatives in Tanzania's 31 regions

resources.description: All indicators in one tidy/long file: national time series 2019-2025 plus regional breakdowns (cooperatives, SACCOS finance, risk, poverty, financial inclusion, agriculture)
Analysis-ready wide file: one row per region (31 regions) with population, cooperative coverage, SACCOS finance, financial inclusion and poverty indicators aligned
